name: Cover: blue professional
description: A consulting-report cover: a slanted tinted panel on the right with a 3 by 3 dot grid in its corner; on the left the series name, a short blue rule, the title, a lede and one line of meta, with the page number bottom left and the progress bar along the bottom edge. A centred title page would lose the document-like left-aligned rhythm and the weight of the slanted panel.

brand.hint: series or deck name, filled automatically from the part of the story title before the colon; leave empty when not needed

title.hint: claim headline, 1 to 2 lines, up to 16 characters; *keyword* marks an emphasis (blue)

subtitle.hint: a lede of 1 to 2 lines, up to 45 characters

meta.hint: occasion, date or confidentiality level, filled automatically from the first clause of occasion (up to 10 characters)

subtitle.value: Three months of data: users drop off at loading and forms, not the feature list.
